items.where: Plant Ecology and Evolution, Department of Ecology and Genetics, Uppsala University, Sweden
items.details: Supervisor: Mario Vallejo-Marín. Project: How new polyploid species form: population genomic insights from Mimulus peregrinus. Whole-genome resequencing to study subgenome ancestry, homoeologous exchange and selection after recent allopolyploidization.

items.what: Postdoctoral Researcher, parallel position (CAPES AURORA Program)
items.where: Department of Botany, Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), Brazil
items.details: Supervisor: Caroline Turchetto. Project: Evolutionary history, genetic diversity and conservation of Nicotiana sect. Alatae in the Campos Sulinos. DArT-seq bioinformatic pipelines, population genomics, gene flow and species delimitation, ecological niche modelling and climate refugia, and training of graduate students in bioinformatics.

items.where: Institute of Plant Molecular and Cellular Biology (IBMCP, CSIC-UPV), Valencia, Spain
items.details: Project: Genomic architecture of rapid diversification in Solanaceae lineages. De novo and reference-guided genome assembly and annotation; structural variant and transposable element characterization; phylogenomics and introgression detection; comparative genomics of gene flow and adaptive evolution; reproducible pipelines in Nextflow.

items.where: Finnish Museum of Natural History, University of Helsinki, Finland
items.details: Research visit to Péter Poczai's group, funded by the ESEB Godfrey Hewitt Mobility Award.

items.where: Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), Brazil
items.details: Project: The highland's bloom: the impact of fast divergence in highland Petunia. Field expeditions and phenotyping, herbarium taxonomy, DNA extraction, genome assembly, population structure, phylogenomics and species delineation, hybridization/introgression detection, demographic inference and environmental association analysis.
RAD-seq genome assembly, evaluation of reference genome quality, and comparison of SNP calling across reference mapping strategies.
